mechanism: At tree comparisons with zero known prefix, use the query first word already supplied in pre. Compare only the candidate word; if equal continue original comparison from8. Nonzero-prefix comparisons use the original function.
difference_from_old_work: R longkey6 lost quality by changing search neighborhoods. This preserves hash/search/insert policies and uses an existing value; no key change, speculative prefetch or search-depth adjustment. An extra branch may still cost more than the saved load.
